integrity: Analytical covariance, derivative, one-crossing and uniqueness arguments are given in RESULT.md; exact identities and numerical comparisons can be reproduced with verify.py. Publication-priority comparisons may be incomplete. The numerical grid does not prove global optimality.
scientific_limitations: One zero-start once-integrated Wiener path, scalar integral on [0,1], exactly one Gaussian sample, same calibrated noise variance across a value or true derivative measurement. Does not address unit conversion, multiple samples, uncertain prior trends, derivative estimation by finite differences, or different risks.
title: Sharp noise-driven choice between value and derivative sensing in integrated-Wiener quadrature
